description: This file defines the OrderEntity class, which extends the Order class and includes various properties related to an order such as totals, payment details, shipping information, status, and date purchased.

classes.name: OrderEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing an order entity with various order-related properties, extending the Order class and serializable for persistence or transfer.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of total amounts associated with the order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves the list of total amounts associated with the order.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the payment type used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for the order.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Returns the payment module name used for the order.

methods.name: getShippingModule
methods.description: Returns the shipping module name used for the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns the credit card information associated with the order.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets the credit card information for the order.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date for the order.

methods.name: setPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Sets the list of previous statuses for the order.

methods.name: getPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the list of previous order statuses.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code used for the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency code for the order.
